text:
emma: Quick heads-up: onboarding orion14b-int4 showed deterministic corruption after ~12.1k context tokens when using our compacted KV pack + RoPE. generation flips to repeating a 64-token span at the wrap.
noah: which rotary_scale/export settings?
emma: exported with rotary_scale=1.0, max_seq=32768. short convs good. long session reproducer pasted below.
ara: can you drop the minimal repro call?
emma: curl -s -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"orion14b-int4","prompt":"<long history...>","max_tokens":4000}'
emma: we feed prompt until context ~12100 then append a question. model starts parroting earlier paragraph after next token.
dinesh: does it happen on int8/fp16? any delta?
emma: int8 & f16 clean. This seems limited to our int4 path + the index-compact logic in kvcache.
noah: logs? paste tail.
emma: ```[2026-03-01T09:44:12Z] kvcache: store pos_base=11588 entry_len=512 shard=2 packed_idx=0x7b3f
[2026-03-01T09:44:12Z] kvcache: load  pos=5789 -> idx_unpacked=0x1234
[2026-03-01T09:44:12Z] kvcache: load  pos=11588 -> idx_unpacked=0x7b3f
[2026-03-01T09:44:13Z] gen: token="the"
[2026-03-01T09:44:13Z] gen: token="same"
[2026-03-01T09:44:13Z] gen: token="paragraph" // repeated verbatim from pos~5790 earlier```
noah: interesting: loaded pos 5789 then loaded 11588 -> those should be different physical slots but packed_idx values look suspiciously similar.
dinesh: could be the packing scheme compresses (pos // entry_len) into 32 bits and we overflow when pos_base > 2^32. but 11588 small. maybe shift/truncation when combining shard/id/len into compact word.
ops-bot: perf/longcache/orion14b-int4: nightly run complete. mismatch-rate 1.4% vs f16 on wrap-set. logs: ci://artifacts/3033334444/nightly.log
ci-bot: analyzer: mismatch-rate measured over 10 long traces crossing the wrap point. root cause hypothesis: index pack truncation.
ara: can we try enabling KV_FULL_INDEXING (no packing) on canary? Noah, Dinesh can you spin that?
dinesh: started a canary with KV_FULL_INDEXING=true and INT4_SAFE_UNPACK enabled. ETA ~18m.
noah: also trying larger entry_len 1024 to see if packing boundary depends on entry size.
dinesh: canary done. result: mismatch-rate -> 0.02% (int4+KV_FULL_INDEXING), latency +3%. artifacts: ci://artifacts/3033334444/kv_fullindex.log
noah: that pretty much nails packing bug. what's the short-term mitigation? fallback to int8 for long requests?
emma: propose runtime rule: if (quant==int4 && tokens_so_far + max_tokens > wrap_threshold) then route to int8 variant OR enable KV_FULL_INDEXING flag per-request. prefer routing for perf predictability.
ara: PR incoming? Add unit tests + fuzz for packing/unpacking around wrap boundaries.
dinesh: opened PR: https://git.internal/r/6121 - fixes pack bitmask to preserve shard/id bits and adds fuzzcases. includes benchmark showing <0.5% memory overhead.
ci-bot: PR 6121 premerge: unit tests passed; regression perf: small mem bump, latency unchanged in core path.
noah: add a replay test that asserts token-equality against f16 on the failing long trace. nightly guard added to long-eval.
emma: added the failing trace to long-eval set and scheduled daily.
ara: ops - please add dedicated-capacity routing rule for canary traffic so large-session clients don't see int4 until we flip. cc @platform-ops.
ops-bot: routing change created: route-rule/disable-int4-long-sessions -> pending approval.
noah: also audit other int4 model builds (orion-lite, aurora11b) for same pack assumptions. I'll add checklist item to the model-onboard playbook.
emma: thanks all. follow-ups: 1) merge pack bitmask fix, 2) enable runtime routing rule, 3) run a 72h burn with long-eval traces, 4) audit int4 model pool.
dinesh: leaving a short postmortem draft in #eng-ml-postmortems once PR lands.
emma: great work team :rocket:
